component.name: hwsight
component.summary: A Device Manager for Linux, in plain English

description.p: hwsight looks at everything inside and plugged into your computer, tells you in plain English what is working and what isn't, explains why, and shows the fix for your distro.

ul.li: Every device, grouped by type, each with a clear status
Problems explained using the kernel log, such as the exact firmware that is missing
Quiet performance problems: slow RAM, a graphics card in a slow slot, a USB drive on a USB 2 port
Three levels of detail, from plain English to every raw value
Firmware updates, one device at a time, only after you confirm
Reads by default; anything that needs admin rights asks through your desktop's own password window

screenshot.caption: Key numbers for a graphics card, each with a verdict
